name: Kentucky
notes: Kentucky supports digital ID through the KY Mobile ID app. Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet are not currently supported.

wallets.name: KY Mobile ID
steps: Download the KY Mobile ID app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create or sign in to your Kentucky Transportation Cabinet account.
Follow the in-app prompts to scan the front and back of your Kentucky driver's license or ID.
Your Mobile ID will be available in the app once approved.
